description: Company snapshot in one call for any SEC-registered company: fundamentals and ratios from the latest annual report (revenue, margins, growth, debt, cash flow, EPS), SEC profile (industry, exchange, state, fiscal year), recent filings (latest 10-K / 10-Q, 8-K events, insider-trading activity in 90 days) and the official website's health (uptime, TLS expiry, email security, registration). Sources: SEC EDGAR (public domain), Wikidata (CC0). Paid ($0.05, x402).

domain.description: Optional website to check instead of the one on record

ticker.description: Ticker of an SEC-registered company, e.g. AAPL, MSFT, BRK-B
